# A cost basis that states its available balance on a transaction that fails,
# and a sale further down the same file that names it.
#
# "This basis's balance came from the file" is module state that no rollback
# undoes, which is why it is noted only once the transaction commits. This
# fixture asks what a file can do with a note taken too early: state a balance
# on a basis, lose the transaction, and still have a sale below skip lowering
# it.
#
# What this fixture produces: two errors and no transactions, only the
# accounts. `txn_type: Z` is refused, so the buy is rolled back and its split
# — guid and all — is never written; the sale below then names a cost basis
# the book does not have and is told so. A balance stated on a transaction
# that did not survive has nothing left to be authoritative about.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_update_strategy_respects_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	txn_type: Z
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "9f1c4b2ae7d54c8fa03b6d18e25c7a41"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
		cost_basis_balance: "100.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"

2026-02-01 * "Sell 40 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-54.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "9f1c4b2ae7d54c8fa03b6d18e25c7a41"
	Assets:Bank 55.60 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "55.60"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
